stories.title: Trump announced a partial Russia-Ukraine ceasefire. Did either country know about it?
stories.summary: Ukraine's leader says Russia is continuing to attack Ukraine and is ignoring an "energy ceasefire" declared by President Trump.

stories.title: Over 1,000 children are buried at juvenile detention centers nationwide
stories.summary: In the woods near a Maryland juvenile detention center, officials found the graves of more than 200 Black boys. It's one of 40 similar gravesites across the country, from Oregon to Maine.

stories.title: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
stories.summary: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

stories.title: A Korean city borrows an educational model from the U.S. amid AI concerns
stories.summary: Some South Korean schools have imported a U.S. educational model to boost literacy skills and independent thinking eroded by AI and a test-focused Korean educational system.

stories.title: California voters consider one-time 5% tax for billionaires
stories.summary: California voters are forming their opinions on a novel way to tax the rich — a proposal to charge 5% one time on billionaires' overall wealth.

stories.title: 61-year-old woman holds plank for 5 hours in quest for new world record
stories.summary: DonnaJean Wilde held a plank for five hours at the Huntsman World Senior Games earlier this month in Utah. It could be a new world record for longest plank held by a woman. But why does she do it?
